facts.fact: The National Assembly adopted Law No. 2014-038 on the protection of personal data in its sitting of 16 December 2014; the text, signed by the Assembly's president, provides for publication in the Journal Officiel and gives no promulgation or commencement date.
facts.system: Loi n° 2014-038 sur la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Article 28 of Law No. 2014-038 institutes an independent authority, the Commission Malagasy de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CMIL), of nine members designated by decree in Council of Ministers, with regulatory and sanctioning powers; the text records no appointment of members.
facts.system: Loi n° 2014-038 sur la protection des données à caractère personnel
